conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Hello. Could you tell me your age and gender, and what brings you in today?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: Hello. I'm 43 years old, female. I came in because my arm has been hurting near my wrist. It started after I hit the pole of the net while playing tennis, and it jarred my arm. It's been swollen a little and hurts when I move my wrist.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Have you experienced any numbness, tingling, or weakness in your hand or fingers? Have you had any prior injuries or conditions affecting your wrist or arm?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: No numbness in my hand, but there's a little pain when I move my wrist. As for prior injuries, I had a trauma from falling on a rake while doing lawn work. I don’t remember any other issues with my wrist or arm before this.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Could you describe the specific movements that cause pain, the presence of any clicking or locking in the wrist, and whether you have experienced any weakness or difficulty gripping objects?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: The movements that cause pain are when I bend my wrist or flex my thumb. I don’t feel any clicking or locking in my wrist, and I haven’t had any trouble gripping objects, but it does hurt when I move it a certain way.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Could you please describe the location of the swelling and whether there is any bruising or deformity visible on your wrist?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: The swelling is on the part of my arm near my wrist, and there's no bruising or deformity that I can see. It's just a little puffy, nothing too bad.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Could you please describe the specific location of the tenderness on your wrist and whether there is any associated stiffness or difficulty in performing daily activities?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: The tenderness is on the part of my arm near my wrist, right around where I hit it on the pole. It's pretty sore when they press there, and it's stiff sometimes, especially when I try to move my wrist or flex my thumb. It makes some daily activities a bit harder, like opening jars or typing, but nothing too bad.

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: No, I haven't had any imaging studies for this injury or any prior wrist issues. The doctor took an X-ray today, and it came back normal, but I wasn't told about any other imaging done before.
